about: National lab tests the patient chat hides (the sensitive test list), each with every one of its names: the name, other names and LOINC name in docs/codes/drafts/hid-medicines-and-lab-tests.csv at c68ef594 (claude/code-list-drafts), and the display and other names in the built seed hid-lab-tests.json (sha256 eff9ba67...). A test is here when the list hid it by any name at 4e41e132, or Ola made it sensitive on 27 Nov 2026 (LAB-0034 urine TB LAM, LAB-0148 cryptococcal antigen, LAB-0087 India ink). Every name must be hidden but the ambiguous ones the walk tests exempt by name: LAB-0080 "PT" (prothrombin time to clinicians) and LAB-0139 "Wet mount", "Wet prep" and "Saline wet mount" (they do not say the sample is vaginal).
